request:
镜头 s04：纪录片中引用的旧资料影像，时长 8 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
风格模式：固定风格（style preset sp01-home48）。锁定外观 / Locked look（detailed_description 第一行必须照此书写，并逐字包含 ['consumer handheld family camera', 'low-bitrate']）：Locked look "2040s family home video" (style preset sp01-home48): a 2040s consumer handheld family camera on full auto; low-bitrate consumer digital video; fixed wide-normal zoom around 28mm equivalent at automatic, deep but soft focus; filter none; grade: warm faded beige, lifted greyish blacks, low saturation; light: available window daylight, auto-exposure pumping, highlights blooming; texture: macroblocking on motion, chroma noise in shadows, slight motion blur, focus hunting; remembered family footage: warm, soft, imperfect, held by a parent's hand.
该类型的纪录片默认机位：archival footage quoted inside a documentary
导演意图（自然语言）：家用摄像机手持（妈妈在拍），轻微晃动。宋工蹲在女儿身边，笑着揉了揉她的头发，说了一句；说完他低头看见桌上的画，笑容慢慢收住了。环境声：厨房的底噪、窗外的城市声。
情绪：warm, tender, a hint of unease
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：medium shot, handheld consumer camera with a soft unsteady sway
景深与虚实：Soft breathing home-video focus; faces moderately sharp, the bright window behind them blown out into warm haze.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Degraded home-video frame in the same sunlit kitchen: Song, a slim 33-year-old man in thin round steel-rimmed glasses and a light-grey cardigan, crouches beside little Nian at the wooden table, laughing, one hand on her head; her crayon drawing lies on the table between them. Blocking lock: Song crouches at frame left beside the table, little Nian sits at frame right, the crayon drawing lies between them in the lower centre; the sunlit window is behind them.
Picture 2: Engineer Song (Song Qi, 33 in 2048, systems engineer on the 550 quantum-computer project) (character reference; role: the protagonist). A 33-year-old Chinese man, systems engineer on a national quantum-computer project. Slim, medium height, short neat black hair with a side parting, clean-shaven, a small mole under his right eye, warm attentive eyes with faint laugh lines, thin round steel-rimmed glasses. Light-grey knitted cardigan over a pale blue collared work shirt, a blank white ID card on a dark lanyard, a cheap black digital wristwatch on his left wrist.
Picture 3: little Nian (Song's daughter, 6 years old in 2048) (character reference; role: the child who asks the question). A 6-year-old Chinese girl with a round face, a straight black bob haircut with blunt bangs, big curious dark eyes, a small gap between her front teeth, rosy cheeks, a mustard-yellow knitted sweater, crayon smudges on her fingers.
Picture 4: the Song family kitchen on the surface in 2048 (location reference; role: location reference). Interior of a small family apartment kitchen on the Earth's surface in 2048, late afternoon: warm sunlight through a window falls across a wooden table with crayons and sheets of drawing paper, a rice cooker and a teapot on the counter, children's drawings stuck on the fridge, a potted plant; through the window a hazy city skyline and, far away on the horizon, the half-built steel scaffold of a colossal engine tower with construction cranes. Empty of people, lived-in.
台词（逐字照抄，按顺序，每句放进一个 <d>[Chinese] ...</d>）：
1. Song (a man in his early thirties, warm and gentle voice with a smile in it) — 宋工（三十出头男性的声音，温和、带笑意）: 傻丫头，它就是一台算得特别快的机器。
现场环境声：quiet kitchen room tone, faint city traffic through the window, a chair creaking
参考词汇（检索所得，只借用术语与思路，不要整段照抄，不得改变锁定外观）：
[ours/sound-home] 声音：家里的午后
[rules/move/documentary-handheld] move
[rules/move/breathing-hold] move
[ours/pace-doc] 节奏：纪录片的呼吸
[ours/arch-dv] 资料退化：DV/低码率数字录像
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。
